extracted.name: Chewy chocolate chip cookies
extracted.description: Great recipe for Chewy chocolate chip cookies.
ingredient_lines: Chocolate chips. ("Measure with your heart" -Tori Phantom)
instruction_lines: Mix the brown sugar, white sugar, butter, vanilla extract, and coffee grounds in a large mixing bowl.
Slowly sift in your all-purpose flour and mix.
Add the chocolate chips/chunks of your choice.
Refrigerate your cookie dough over night or at least for a few hours. The longer, the better.
Scoop your cookie dough onto a non-stick cookie sheet, making sure to leave room in between each cookie so they don't stick together when baking.
